expanded_title: Sit-Down With Isaac Trumbo, President of Champions Group & Knighted Ventures, Ahead of Champions Social Club’s May 14 Soft Opening
expanded_deck: Meeting inside Champions Social Club in Dallas with Isaac Trumbo, President of Champions Group and Knighted Ventures, ahead of the venue's May 14 soft opening.
expanded_body:
Originally posted May 6, 2026.

Had a great sit-down inside Champions Social Club in Dallas with Isaac Trumbo, President of Champions Group and Knighted Ventures, ahead of the club's May 14, 2026 soft opening (and the May 30 Grand Opening celebration at 17776 Dallas Parkway).

From the chess lounges to the live-stream production setup and the main poker floor, we talked through the vision behind bringing the Champions brand to North Texas.

Champions Social Club soft opening: May 14, 2026.

— Sham
author: Shomari Williams
